metadata.summary: CT-RATE provides 50,188 volumetric chest CT scans (25,692 unique scans) from 21,304 patients, each paired with a structured radiology report (2.7M impression statements). It includes multi-organ segmentation masks (CT-RATE-2) and a radiology report labeling pipeline.
metadata.purpose: Multi-organ abnormality detection, report generation, vision-language modeling.

papers.title: CT-RATE: A Multi-organ CT with 2.7M Radiology Text Reports and Lung Nodule Masks

ethics.privacy_measures: De-identification assumed per clinical data release norms; not explicitly described.

known_limitations: Report labels auto-extracted (RadBERT), introducing possible label noise.
Reports translated from Turkish to English, potentially losing nuance or introducing bias.
bias_and_limitations.modifications: Yes — labels extracted algorithmically from free text; reports translated.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: Single-center (Istanbul Medipol University); no demographic or geographic diversity reported.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Limited generalizability due to single-center, Turkish-origin, English-translated reports and RadBERT-derived labels.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No subgroup coverage details provided (e.g., age, sex, ethnicity, comorbidities).
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: No explicit description of missing data volume or patterns.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Single-center clinical chest CTs with associated radiology reports.
data_origin.sampling_strategy: Not explicitly described; derived from consecutive clinical exams at Istanbul Medipol University.

population.missing_groups: No external/site diversity; no pediatric, elderly, or critical-care subgroup specification provided.

annotation.annotation_method: Labels extracted from free-text radiology reports using RadBERT.
annotation.labeling_provenance: Radiology reports originally written in English via Turkish-to-English translation pipeline; labels auto-extracted with RadBERT.
annotation.label_noise_description: RadBERT-based extraction introduces possible label noise; reports are English-translated from Turkish clinical practice.
